_doc: Ready v1 C13. Danger tiers of the threat badge/compass (scripts/sim/threat_map.gd describe(); thresholds are the same 0..100 scale). `shield` is the pip value on the compass/HUD danger badge (1..5 pips). `level` is the player level the tier is balanced for: tools_qa/v1/duel_sim.gd must show a 70-85 % win rate for the `fights` of a tier at that level. Enemy levels are the Region 1 spawn levels the sim feeds CombatStats.stats().
